description: Four jacks carrying the average of what every connected collaborator is sending on that channel

outputs.text: The average of that channel across every collaborator who is sending, and 0V when nobody is

notes: the divisor is the number of collaborators sending on any channel at all, so somebody sending on channel 1 alone counts against the average on the other three as well
the module reads every peer slot on the Resonance Hub in the same unbroken row, takes no slot of its own, and can go anywhere to the right of the Hub
the ring around a jack glows with the voltage it is carrying, orange for positive and cyan for negative
